units.name: Levies
units.description: Ordinary troops raised from your people. Every nation has them, and they fill out any stack.

units.name: Club warriors
units.description: Tribal fighters with heavy clubs, stronger than levies when attacking.

units.name: Spear throwers
units.description: Throw spears from cover, best when holding ground.

units.name: Horse archers
units.description: Mounted archers: fast, and quick to take land.

units.name: Spearmen
units.description: Medieval foot soldiers with long spears, solid in attack and defence.

units.name: Swordsmen
units.description: Armoured swordsmen who hit hard.

units.name: Archers
units.description: Longbowmen, the best defenders of their era.

units.name: Pikemen
units.description: A wall of pikes that is very hard to push back, though a little slow.

units.name: Knights
units.description: Heavy cavalry with the strongest attack, the fastest to take land, and costly.

units.name: Catapult
units.description: Hurls stones for the stack it goes with, and halves the troops it costs to take another nation's land around it.

units.name: Trebuchet
units.description: A heavy, slow siege engine that reaches further than a catapult and cuts the cost of taking land around it to a third.

units.name: Galley
units.description: An oared warship that carries up to 120 troops across water and fights other ships well.

units.name: Cog
units.description: A sailing ship that carries up to 200 troops, faster than a galley but weaker in a fight.

units.name: Musketeers
units.description: The all-round soldier of the Gunpowder era, good at attacking and holding.

units.name: Line infantry
units.description: Drilled ranks with bayonets, the best at holding ground.

units.name: Grenadiers
units.description: Throw grenades to break defenders: the strongest attack, weak in defence, and costly.

units.name: Light cavalry
units.description: Fast horsemen, the quickest to take land.

units.name: Cannon
units.description: Cuts the cost of taking land around it to a third, like a trebuchet, but moves faster and hits far harder in battle.

units.name: Galleon
units.description: A big sailing ship that carries up to 300 troops and can defend itself.

units.name: Frigate
units.description: A fast warship that carries up to 80 troops and hunts other ships.

units.name: Ship of the line
units.description: The strongest ship of its age, slow and costly, carrying up to 150 troops.

units.name: Transport boat
units.description: A free boat that carries a whole stack across water when there is no way by land. It sails on its own, lands, and is gone; warships can sink it with everyone aboard.

units.name: Trade ship
units.description: A free ship that sails between ports and earns gold for both ends. Hostile warships capture it and take it home.

units.name: Riflemen
units.description: The all-round soldier of the Industrial era, a third stronger than a musketeer.

units.name: Machine gunners
units.description: Hold a line like nothing before them, but are slow and poor at taking land.

units.name: Mortar teams
units.description: Lob shells into trenches to break defenders; weak when attacked.

units.name: Stormtroopers
units.description: Elite assault troops, the best at taking land, and costly.

units.name: Field artillery
units.description: Long-range guns that cut the cost of taking land within 5 plots and hit hard in battle.

units.name: Early tank
units.description: An armoured machine that fights in battle and helps take the land around it.

units.name: Steamship
units.description: A fast steel transport that carries up to 600 troops and can defend itself.

units.name: Ironclad
units.description: An armoured battleship, the strongest at sea, carrying up to 100 troops.

units.name: Destroyer
units.description: A fast warship that hunts other ships from 3 plots, carrying up to 60 troops. It can hit submarines running submerged.

units.name: Biplane fighter
units.description: A fighter. It flies from its airfield to patrol a spot and shoots down enemy planes within 2 plots, then flies home to rearm when its fuel runs low.

units.name: Bomber
units.description: A bomber that reaches anywhere on the map from its airfield. It flies to a spot and drops its bombs: companies there lose troops, buildings are damaged, and the land is easier to take for a while.

units.name: Soldiers
units.description: Modern infantry with automatic rifles, the backbone of a Modern army.

units.name: Special forces
units.description: Small, fast elite units: the best at taking land, and the costliest troops.

units.name: Anti-tank teams
units.description: Teams with rocket launchers that hold ground hard: the best Modern defenders.

units.name: Main battle tank
units.description: A heavy Modern tank, fast and strong in battle, that helps take the land around it.

units.name: APC
units.description: An armoured carrier that takes up to 300 troops at vehicle speed and sets them down where it stops, with no loss.

units.name: Rocket artillery
units.description: Rocket launchers that cut the cost of taking land within 6 plots and hit hard in battle.

units.name: Paratroopers
units.description: Soldiers trained to jump. Only paratroopers board a transport plane, which drops them anywhere within its reach.

units.name: Jet fighter
units.description: A fast fighter with a long reach. It patrols a spot and shoots down enemy planes within 3 plots, then flies home to rearm when its fuel runs low.

units.name: Strategic bomber
units.description: A heavy bomber that reaches anywhere on the map and can cross it several times on one load of fuel. It drops three bombs in a line across its target, then flies home.

units.name: Attack helicopter
units.description: Slow and low. It hovers over a spot and shoots enemy companies and vehicles within 2 plots. Fighters, flak and SAMs bring it down.

units.name: Transport helicopter
units.description: Lifts one company of up to 200 troops and sets it down on any land within reach of its base. On enemy land the company lands fighting.

units.name: Transport plane
units.description: Carries up to 500 paratroopers and drops them anywhere within its long reach. About 1 in 20 is lost in the jump.

units.name: SAM truck
units.description: A mobile missile launcher. It fires at enemy planes within 6 plots and carries 2 missiles, reloaded for gold. Set it to follow a company to cover it from the air.

units.name: Cruiser
units.description: A Modern warship that fights ships, hunts submarines running submerged, and fires at enemy planes within 3 plots.

units.name: Battleship
units.description: The heaviest warship. It shells enemy companies on the coast within 4 plots and makes land there a third as costly to take.

units.name: Submarine
units.description: Fires torpedoes at ships. In open ocean only destroyers, cruisers, submarines and helicopters can hit it; in deep ocean nothing can, until it fires.

units.name: Aircraft carrier
units.description: A floating airfield for up to 12 planes. Their reach is measured from wherever the carrier is, and it rearms 6 at once.

units.name: Landing craft
units.description: After Amphibious warfare, the free boats that carry a stack across water are landing craft: faster, and losing half as many troops in the landing.
